properties.name: Whangpoo River (schematic)
properties.method: Northern reach follows cached Natural Earth rivernum 582; southern reach is a generalized geographic connector, not a digitized 1937 shoreline. Width is illustrative.

properties.name: Soochow Creek (schematic)
properties.method: Western reach joins Natural Earth rivernum 582 at 121.302745,31.233832. Urban reach is a generalized anchor-based connector constrained by the Sihang north-bank site, Tibet Road Bridge and the Huangpu confluence; not surveyed or georeferenced historical meanders.

properties.name: Wenzaobang (schematic)
properties.method: Generalized west-east water obstacle from the Wusong River to Wusong/Huangpu, constrained by Huangdu, Nanxiang and the northern battlefield regions. Modern dredging has changed the channel; bends and width are illustrative, not 1937 hydrography.
